# StarMapper — LLM Navigation Index
# https://starmapper.bruniaux.com
# Format: plain list, one entry per line. Full index: PROJECT_INDEX.md

## Project identity
- StarMapper maps GitHub stargazers on an interactive world map
- Stack: Next.js 16, TypeScript 5, MapLibre GL 5, Prisma 7 + Neon Postgres, Tailwind v4
- Deployment: Vercel Hobby (10s function limit → client-side chunk loop architecture)

## Authoritative spec
- CLAUDE.md — full project spec, architecture, file map, conventions, gotchas
- PROJECT_INDEX.md — this index, human-readable
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — deep architecture doc

## Entry points by task
- Add API route → src/app/api/chunk/route.ts (example) + .claude/rules/architecture.md
- Modify geocoding → src/lib/geocoder.ts
- Change map rendering → src/components/map/stargazer-map.tsx
- Update DB schema → prisma/schema.prisma + npx prisma db push
- Add component → src/components/ + .claude/rules/design-system.md
- Write tests → .claude/rules/tdd-mandatory.md + src/lib/*.test.ts

## Key source files
- src/app/api/chunk/route.ts — hot path: GitHub fetch + geocode + return points
- src/app/[owner]/[repo]/page.tsx — client chunk loop orchestration + map page
- src/lib/geocoder.ts — 3-tier cascade: Jawg → Geoapify → Nominatim + geocache
- src/lib/github.ts — GitHub GraphQL paginator (100 users/call)
- src/lib/db.ts — Prisma singleton with Neon adapter
- src/lib/organic-score.ts — organic score model
- src/lib/user-cache.ts — bulk upsert with DB health guard
- prisma/schema.prisma — all DB models
- src/app/globals.css — CSS tokens (@theme inline)

## Exported types
- StargazerPoint → src/app/api/chunk/route.ts
- UnmappedUser → src/app/api/chunk/route.ts
- UserDetail → src/app/api/user-details/route.ts

## Key conventions
- Arrow functions only (no function keyword)
- type over interface
- No arbitrary Tailwind values (bg-background not bg-[#0d1117])
- Nominatim: 1100ms between calls, always check geocache first
- GitHub cursor: never pass null as GraphQL variable
- All Prisma calls in try/catch (graceful degradation if DB down)

## Test infrastructure
- Framework: Vitest
- Run: pnpm test | pnpm test:coverage
- Coverage thresholds: 60% global, 70% src/lib/

## CI workflows
- .github/workflows/ci.yml — typecheck + lint + test + Semgrep SAST
- .github/workflows/audit.yml — pnpm audit (weekly + PR gate on package.json changes)

## Architecture decisions (out of scope = will not build)
- No auth / user accounts
- No star history over time
- No real-time webhooks
- No server-side rate limit queuing

## Chrome Extension
- extension/README.md — dev setup, build, zip
- extension/wxt.config.ts — WXT manifest + permissions
- extension/entrypoints/content.ts — button injection on GitHub pages
- extension/entrypoints/background.ts — context menu service worker
- extension/entrypoints/popup/ — toolbar popup (vanilla TS + HTML)
